title: Senior Technician
salary_note: No salary given on the careers page — page must say 'Competitive salary'.
experience: Previous experience in an automotive workshop or a similar technical position would be considered an asset
description_text:
Our client, a well-established automotive group in Malta, is looking for an experienced and technically skilled Senior Automotive Technician to join its workshop team.
 The successful candidate will be responsible for diagnosing and repairing mechanical and electrical vehicle faults, carrying out servicing and maintenance, and supporting the development of other team members through technical guidance and training.
 Key Responsibilities
 Inspect vehicles to identify mechanical, electrical, and technical faults and determine the necessary repairs.
 Carry out vehicle diagnostics using specialised equipment.
 Perform full and partial wiring harness replacements and repairs.
 Ensure all servicing and repair work is completed efficiently, within agreed timeframes, and in accordance with manufacturer specifications.
 Conduct road tests when required to verify vehicle performance and completed repairs.
 Record all work carried out, including additional faults and servicing requirements, accurately on job cards.
 Review work orders with supervisors and plan repair procedures using relevant technical manuals.
 Keep the Workshop and Aftersales Manager informed about vehicle conditions, potential faults, and any safety concerns.
 Support workshop planning and ensure work is carried out according to the scheduled workload.
 Protect customer vehicles and their contents throughout the repair process.
 Handle tools, equipment, and vehicle parts responsibly, ensuring appropriate storage and disposal.
 Maintain a clean, organised, and safe working environment.
 Keep up to date with new vehicle models, technical specifications, and manufacturer standards.
 Attend specialised training locally or abroad when required.
 Provide technical guidance and internal training to colleagues, assisting with more complex technical issues.
 Support the Garage Manager with daily workshop operations and additional duties when required.
 Requirements
 Strong technical knowledge of vehicle mechanics, electrical systems, tools, repairs, and maintenance.
 Previous experience in an automotive workshop or a similar technical position would be considered an asset.
 Excellent diagnostic and problem-solving abilities.
 Good communication and teamwork skills.
 Fluency in both Maltese and English.
 Computer literacy.
 A genuine interest in vehicles and automotive technology.
 Ability to work independently while supporting the wider workshop team.
 What Our Client Offers
 Health insurance.
 Specialised training opportunities locally and abroad.
 Employee loyalty card.
 Opportunities to develop technical expertise within an established automotive group.
 If you have a passion for vehicles, strong technical abilities, and enjoy sharing your knowledge with others, we would love to hear from you. Apply today!
